description: Test-only case (slice M7a). The working student's shift clashes with session 2 of weeks 2-6 (sessions 4, 6, 8, 10, 12), and they can miss 2 shifts before the job is lost. They attend sessions 4 and 6 (shift missed, 1 and 2 of 2), make no plan for session 8 (they go to the shift: absent, a routine cause, so not a valid reason), and attend session 10: the third missed shift loses the job. From then on the shift no longer clashes with session 12.
